verdict.rationale: Installation media is a fair question for a desktop OS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a tool for creating bootable USB media, a downloadable live/installer image, or the USB install flow. Community reports of installing Fedora on laptops (replacing Windows on a Lenovo, setting up a Framework) suggest bare-metal installs happen, but they say nothing about how bootable media is created or used, so they cannot credit this story.
